projects.name: Relay

classification.primary_purpose: Upskill the learner from novice/junior toward independent feature ownership and later senior judgment

projects.summary: Multi-tenant CSV/XLSX onboarding with a Next.js review interface, PostgreSQL state and a separate .NET worker. Real tests demonstrate 100k row recovery, reviewed schema evolution, local AI proposals and remote receipt reconciliation. Deployment and human-learning completion are tracked separately.

ci_cd: GitHub Actions definition; hosted execution not observed
ai_llm: Xenova/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 local embedding model; not an LLM

style: request API plus durable background worker
architecture.data_flow_summary: upload → stage → map/transform → validate/correct → version-bound approval → local transaction or remote outbox/receipts → per-row report
architecture.deployment: Native localhost verified; standalone and Docker definitions supplied; public deployment pending target

Insert-only local and remote reconciliation preserving subsequent destination edits

Pause/cancel/retry and receipt-only reconciliation for inactive external jobs
Fair per-tenant batch scheduling and worker schema-capability filtering
Worker health, phase metrics, RSS, batch traces and external trace-context propagation
Paginated review interface, keyboard dialogs, mobile layout and streamed row reports
Single-use invitations, password change/session revocation and administrative reset/bootstrap
Real PostgreSQL snapshot backup, immutable-original verification and isolated restore rehearsal
Foundations-first curriculum with runnable starters, five learning gates, 12 later Relay labs, coaching contract and machine-readable learner state

complexity.scale: 0–10 qualitative repository assessment, not a standardized benchmark

learning_material.description: Seven foundations sessions, runnable TypeScript exercises, five evidence-based gates, two independent feature briefs and twelve later Relay labs.
learning_material.completeness: Curriculum authored; actual learner effectiveness, mastery, independent review and human handover unassessed
learning_material.effectiveness: Unmeasured; previous qualitative learning-value score is potential, not demonstrated learner progress

strengths: actual neural evaluation with retained failure
weaknesses: Public hosting target not supplied; private GitHub repository created
Docker definitions authored; Docker unavailable locally
Independent review/human handover and learner mastery not observed
External integration is a controlled test API with strong receipts, not an arbitrary CRM
English-header AI benchmark is small; similarity is not calibrated confidence
Parser restart rescans a logical-record prefix; opening a workbook may scan the archive
Source storage is one shared durable volume, not cross-host object storage
API-enforced tenant isolation; no PostgreSQL RLS claim
Malformed input reports only its staged prefix; unstaged source records are not falsely counted
External requests already authorized for sending may complete after pause/cancel
learning_opportunities: Practise rollback, review and operational judgment
recommended_next_steps: Attempt the short diagnostic and name-cleaning exercise
Review learner evidence and adjust placement
Progress through independent feature ownership before advanced electives
